name: sail_a
prompt: Close view of a big canvas sail on an old wooden sailing ship as a gust of wind fills it, the heavy cloth snapping and flapping loudly against the rigging. Audio: loud flapping and snapping of heavy canvas sailcloth in the wind, a sharp whump as the sail fills, rope creak, nothing else.

name: sail_b
prompt: A loose square sail on a tall ship luffs and cracks in a stiff breeze while sailors haul on the sheets. Audio: heavy canvas sail fluttering and cracking like a whip in strong wind, then filling taut with a deep thump, no voices.

name: musket_a
prompt: A row of red-coated marines on the deck of an 18th century warship fire their flintlock muskets together in one volley, a burst of white smoke. Audio: a crackling ragged volley of many flintlock musket shots fired almost at once, sharp pops and bangs, then silence, no voices.

name: musket_b
prompt: Pirates crouched along the rail of a wooden ship fire a ragged volley of muskets and pistols across the water, smoke drifting. Audio: a rapid crackle of a dozen gunshots from old black powder muskets, sharp cracks overlapping, a short echo over the sea.

name: cheer_a
prompt: The rough crew of a pirate ship cheer in triumph on deck after winning a sea battle, throwing their hats in the air and waving cutlasses. Audio: a crowd of rough men cheering loudly together, a joyful roar of hurrah, whooping and shouting in celebration, no music.

name: cheer_b
prompt: Sailors on the deck of an old sailing ship give three rousing cheers for their captain, fists raised. Audio: a big crowd of men shouting hip hip hurrah together, a loud hearty victorious cheer, no music.

name: groan_a
prompt: The broken wooden hull of a sinking sailing ship rolls over and slips beneath the waves, masts toppling. Audio: a deep agonised groaning and creaking of strained ship timbers, a long wooden moan, then a heavy gurgling rush of water swallowing the hull, bubbles, no voices.

name: groan_b
prompt: Underwater and at the surface, a wrecked wooden ship sinks slowly, air bursting from its hold. Audio: deep low groaning of wood under great pressure, then loud bubbling and gurgling water as the ship goes down, ominous, no voices.

name: fanfare_a
prompt: An 18th century naval band of fifes and drums on a ship's quarterdeck plays a short triumphant flourish to celebrate a victory at sea. Audio: a short bright triumphant fanfare, a rising heroic brass trumpet call with a drum roll ending on a held major chord, no voices.

name: fanfare_b
prompt: Two natural trumpeters in tricorn hats on the deck of a victorious ship sound a brief jubilant call while a drummer rolls. Audio: a brief proud victorious trumpet fanfare in a major key, bright brass flourish with a snare drum roll, then a final ringing note, no voices.

name: defeat_a
prompt: A grim dark scene of a defeated sinking ship at dusk, a lone drummer beats a slow funeral beat. Audio: a short sombre musical sting, a single low mournful horn note sliding down over one deep slow drum hit, dark and sad, fading out, no voices.

name: defeat_b
prompt: Smoke over a lost sea battle, the captain's flag lowered. Audio: a short ominous low minor-key sting, deep cello and low brass descending notes with a heavy timpani boom, sorrowful, ending quietly, no voices.

name: quill_a
prompt: Close view of a goose feather quill pen drawing a line across an old parchment sea chart on a wooden table by candlelight. Audio: the dry scratching of a quill pen nib on rough parchment paper, a short quick stroke, nothing else, quiet room.

name: quill_b
prompt: A navigator's hand marks a course on an old map with a quill, then taps it down. Audio: a crisp short scratch of a quill pen on thick paper followed by a soft tap, nothing else.

name: page_a
prompt: Close view of a hand turning a single thick yellowed page of an old leather-bound ship's logbook on a wooden desk. Audio: a single crisp rustling page turn of thick old paper, nothing else, quiet room.

name: page_b
prompt: An old captain flips one heavy parchment page in a big leather journal. Audio: one soft papery whoosh and rustle of a heavy page being turned and laid flat, nothing else.

name: seal_a
prompt: Close view of a brass seal pressed firmly into a blob of hot red wax on a folded letter on a wooden desk. Audio: a single soft dull thump of a seal stamp pressing into wax on a wooden table, a tiny squish, nothing else.

name: splash_d
prompt: A cannonball falls short and plunges into the sea beside a wooden ship, throwing up a tall white column of spray. Audio: one heavy sudden splash of a heavy object hitting the water, a deep plunge and a shower of falling spray, nothing else.

name: splash_e
prompt: An iron cannonball misses its target and smacks into the waves, a geyser of water shooting up. Audio: a single loud sharp splash and plop into deep water, with spray pattering down after, nothing else.
